subject: Minecart Top Dog
text: A player failed on one emulator and then unlocked Minecart Top Dog using the SNES9X 2010 core.

evidence.quote: Was on incorrect emulator. SNES9X 2010 did it!

subject: Minecart Top Dog
text: A finish time of 2:16:38 still unlocked Minecart Top Dog.

evidence.quote: I got 2:16:38 and it still worked!

subject: Minecart Top Dog
text: Speedrunners regularly beat the Mine Cart Race in under 2 minutes, so there is room for errors, and a linked video shows the route.

evidence.quote: Speedrunners do this regularly in under 2 minutes, so we have enough room for errors.

subject: Minecart Top Dog
text: The minecart has 5 speeds and its default speed is 3.

evidence.quote: Imagine the minecart has 5 speeds...Your default speed is 3.

subject: Minecart Top Dog
text: Tapping or holding the brakes reduces minecart speed by 1.

evidence.quote: Tapping or holding the brakes reduces your speed by 1.

subject: Minecart Top Dog
text: Surviving a hairpin turn requires speed 2.

evidence.quote: Surviving a hairpin turn requires speed 2.

subject: Minecart Top Dog
text: A mushroom sets the minecart speed to 5, so after using one you must tap the brake button 3 times to survive a hairpin turn.

evidence.quote: A mushroom sets your speed to 5.
To survive a hairpin turn after using a mushroom, you need to TAP the brake button 3 times.

subject: Minecart Top Dog
text: Once you are turning you have survived the turn and can use a mushroom again.

evidence.quote: As soon as your turning, you've survived the turn and can use a mushroom again.

subject: Minecart Top Dog
text: In the first overhead section, jump to get the first mushroom and use it immediately.

evidence.quote: Jump to get the mushroom and immediately use it.

subject: Minecart Top Dog
text: After the first overhead section you should have 1 mushroom remaining and be at no more than 0:50:00.

evidence.quote: You should have 1 mushroom remaining and be at no more than 0:50:00.

subject: Minecart Top Dog
text: In the first sidescroller section, mash X with one hand to constantly spend all mushrooms and go as fast as possible.

evidence.quote: mash X to constantly spend all your mushrooms to go as fast as possible.

subject: Minecart Top Dog
text: You should finish the first sidescroller section below 1:05:00.

evidence.quote: You should finish below 1:05:00.

subject: Minecart Top Dog
text: In the second overhead section, immediately use a mushroom, jump, brake, jump, use a mushroom, then brake twice when nearing the hairpin turn.

evidence.quote: Immediately use a mushroom, jump, brake, jump, use mushroom, then when you're nearing the hairpin turn, brake twice.

subject: Minecart Top Dog
text: In the second overhead section, hold left and then jump to take the shortcut, without boosting.

evidence.quote: Hold left and then jump to take the shortcut. Don't boost, just brake once

subject: Minecart Top Dog
text: At the end of the second overhead section, being below 1:50:00 is enough even if you miss a jump in the next section, and being over 1:56:00 means you should start over.

evidence.quote: If you're below 1:50:00, you've got it even if you miss a jump in the next section. If you're over 1:56:00, start over.

subject: Minecart Top Dog
text: In the second sidescroller, jump when you are 1 support beam before the bottom of the first 3 valleys to get 2 mushrooms.

evidence.quote: Jump when you're 1 support beam before the bottom of the first 3 valleys to get 2 mushrooms.

subject: Minecart Top Dog
text: Always spam mushrooms in the sidescrollers and avoid terrible paths in the overhead sections, which do not need many mushrooms.

evidence.quote: make sure that you are always spamming mushrooms in the sidescrollers
don't even need to use a lot of mushrooms there

subject: Minecart Top Dog
text: You can pause during the minecart race and the achievement still unlocks.

evidence.quote: You can pause and the achievement still pops.

subject: Minecart Top Dog
text: Saving a lot of mushrooms for the sidescrolling section made the achievement easier than memorizing a complicated overhead route.

evidence.quote: saved a ton of shrooms for the side scrolling section and it made it way easier than memorizing a super complicated route

subject: Minecart Top Dog
text: Memorizing the sidescrollers so you can pick up and use mushrooms will get you within the target time.

evidence.quote: Memorizing those so you can pick up and use shrooms will get you within the target.

subject: Minecart Top Dog
text: Do not crash, take the good path on the overhead sections, and never stop spamming mushrooms on the sidescrollers.

evidence.quote: Just dont crash and get the
On sidescrollers, dont stop spamming mushrooms and try to get as many as you can.

subject: A Hole's a Hole
text: In Moleville, buy Fireworks for 500 gold from the adult male mole in the house behind the shop.

evidence.quote: Go to the house behind the shop
for 500 gold. Buy it.

subject: A Hole's a Hole
text: Trade the Fireworks to the hidden child female mole near the boxes outside that house for a Shine Stone.

evidence.quote: Talk to her and trade your Fireworks for a...Shine Stone

subject: A Hole's a Hole
text: Inside the shop, trade the Shine Stone to the child female mole for a Carbo Cookie.

evidence.quote: Go into the shop and trade your Shine Stone with the...Carbo Cookie

subject: A Hole's a Hole
text: Give the Carbo Cookie to the child female mole stuck in the wooden bucket in the far upper left corner outside, and she will come out.

evidence.quote: In exchange for the Carbo Cookie, she will come out.

subject: A Hole's a Hole
text: After the mole leaves the bucket, leaving town, entering any house or shop, saving, or entering the mine means the whole sequence must be redone, and you should leave and re-enter town before restarting.

evidence.quote: sair da cidade, entrar em qualquer casa ou loja, salvar o game ou entrar na mina
evidence.translation: leave town, enter any house or shop, save the game or enter the mine

evidence.quote: Terá de fazer tudo de novo
evidence.translation: You will have to do everything again

evidence.quote: saia da cidade e entre novamente pra depois recomeçar
evidence.translation: leave the town and enter again before restarting

subject: Art of Balance
text: In the Booster's Tower room with a treasure chest and a ledge, dropping off the ledge onto the seesaw launches the Bob-omb into the air and it bounces you back into the chest.

evidence.quote: If you drop off the ledge and land on the seesaw, you launch the Bob-omb into the air and it bounces you back into the chest.

subject: Art of Balance
text: The seesaw positioning is very specific, so you may need to climb back up and retry several times.

evidence.quote: You might need to do this a few times because the positioning is very specific, but you can climb back up and try again.

subject: Booster's Little Secret
text: Press the button in Booster's castle and then go to Booster Pass to reach the secret area.

evidence.quote: press button in castle of booster and after go to bosster pass.

subject: Promotion Boosting
text: The secret area in Booster Pass must be unlocked before attempting this achievement.

evidence.quote: The secret area in Booster Pass needs to be unlocked before doing this.

subject: Promotion Boosting
text: Entering the secret area triggers a Snifit Apprentice battle, and losing the battle gets the Snifit promoted.

evidence.quote: Enter the secret area and you'll stumble upon a Snifit Apprentice running towards you and into a battle. Lose the battle and the Snifit will be promoted for defeating you.

subject: Promotion Boosting
text: Four more Snifits must be lost to in the area, and one player says to exit to the World Map and re-enter the secret area between them.

evidence.quote: There are four more Snifits that you must lose to in this area
exit to the World Map and re-enter the secret area and lose a battle to every one of them

subject: Promotion Boosting
text: Another player says you do not need to exit the area, only the room in particular.

evidence.quote: you don't need to exit the area, just the room in particular.

subject: Promotion Boosting
text: Fighting instant-death enemies like those in Star Hill can put Mario and two others in critical condition, since the apprentice has pitiful stats and may run out of FP before doing damage.

evidence.quote: to have Mario and two others in critical condition
the apprentice will probably just run out of FP before being able to do any significant damage

subject: Promotion Boosting
text: You only need to lose your endgame HP once; after the first Snifit game over the party is revived at 1 HP.

evidence.quote: You only need to lose your endgame level HP ONCE.
Once you get a game over from the first snifit you all get revived at 1 hp

subject: Promotion Boosting
text: After being defeated by a Snifit Apprentice you are not returned to your last save but respawn with low HP, so get the party to low HP beforehand.

evidence.quote: After being defeated by the snift apprentice you wont be booted to your last save like with other enemies

subject: Promotion Boosting
text: Unequip everything and get as close as possible to 1 HP before the fights.

evidence.quote: unequip everything and get as close as possible to 1HP.

subject: Promotion Boosting
text: Have the Goodie Bag before the fights and use it constantly instead of defending to save time.

evidence.quote: make sure you have the Goodie Bag before fighting them and just use it constantly so you dont have to defend as waste time.

subject: Promotion Boosting
text: Only 5 Snifit Apprentices actually need to defeat you, even though the description says 8.

evidence.quote: it's only 5 dudes you gotta let beat up on you
it is just 5 of them

subject: The Mario Behind the Curtain
text: One player unlocked this by accident while checking for hidden items in Booster's Tower.

evidence.quote: Earned this by accident. Was checking for hidden items.

subject: Curtain Sneak
text: Save before the minigame fight, fight Booster, then load the save to never get caught.

evidence.quote: saving before the minigame fight him then load the save to never get caught

subject: Curtain Sneak and Locomotive Loser
text: Both achievements can be earned on one file by saving first, getting caught and fighting Booster, then reloading without saving after the fight to avoid getting caught.

evidence.quote: save before, get caught and fight him for that achievement, then reload the save (don't save after fighting him) to avoid getting caught and unlock this achievement.

subject: Curtain Sneak
text: Do this achievement last, because only then can you get an accessory that gives a decent Magic boost.

evidence.quote: Its better to do this one last since only then you can get the...accessory which gives a decent Magic boost.

subject: Locomotive Loser
text: A player found the Booster fight surprisingly easy on a level 3 run using Rock Candy and Mario's Full Jump.

evidence.quote: suprisingly easy on Lvl 3 run. Rock Candy + Mario Full Jump
